scope: Complete author reading of all eight Reference pages, all five CLI pages, all three Inspector pages and all three Search pages, reconciled with the isolated-wheel CLI declaration generator, settings tests, package/workflow bounds and focused search/inspector tests. This does not execute every CLI callback, certify every internal symbol as public or establish production search/diagnostic behavior.

reviews.reason: Routes readers by contract and explicitly separates parser/import evidence from runtime behavior and stable API status.
Matches Python and web dependency bounds, the PostgreSQL 16 matrix and route/session cleanup qualifications.
Summarizes actual ViewSet, serializer, permission, authentication, HTTP and action boundaries without presenting a complete internal catalog.
Matches supported query builders and terminals, write and relation behavior, migrations, transactions and manager limitations.
Separates ORM, driver, validation and HTTP families, including the generic CHECK mapping and transport-specific response shapes.
Documents real sync/async boundaries and py.typed support without claiming strict typing, a mypy plugin or fictional public result types.
Provides the authoritative global settings, environment and constructor map, including the known origin-list defect and explicit-list workaround.
Exactly matches 117 command/group declarations from isolated installed 0.7.0 and states that parser metadata does not execute callbacks.
Separates common stable commands, Doctor exit policy, global flag placement and optional experimental families.
Connects scaffold, migration, serving, Doctor, task and client generation commands to the prerequisites and known boundaries in their guides.
Uses registered nested command names and distinguishes local output, provider execution, plan application, MCP and Durable Operations.
Accurately treats format/lint/typecheck/test as external-tool wrappers and bounds shell, query inspection, generators and absent Django-like aliases.
Replaces nonexistent framework command-extension APIs with a normal application entry point and explicit lifecycle, authority and test ownership.
Separates declaration/process diagnostics from deployed-schema and production-performance proof.
Matches declaration-derived summaries and silent registry skips while disclosing synthetic constraints and schema limits.
Explains process-local traces and the synthetic EXPLAIN fallback, including misleading analyze labeling retained as a separate runtime defect.
Defines the indexed artifacts, in-memory lifecycle and local TF-IDF semantics without promising record search, provider embeddings or authorization.
Matches add, replace, token cache, filters, keyword/TF-IDF/hybrid weights and result-limit behavior and leaves relevance to application validation.
Lists the implemented search routes and discloses the process-global, non-tenant-partitioned cache and descriptive local provider label.
